evals.prompt: I need a comprehensive competitive analysis of the electric vehicle charging infrastructure market in Europe — who are the main players, what are the pricing models, what's the regulatory environment like, and what should a new entrant's go-to-market strategy look like? I need this to be thorough enough to present to our board next week.
evals.expected_output: A multi-section document covering market landscape, pricing models, regulatory overview, and strategic recommendations. Should show the HIVE ANALYSIS block, agent roster, and produce an integrated deliverable.
assertions: Output contains a HIVE ANALYSIS block with task family, coupling score, and coordination mode
At least one final deliverable file exists in outputs/ directory
Deliverable mentions at least 3 real EV charging companies by name
Deliverable contains a go-to-market strategy or strategic recommendations section
Output shows an agent roster with named roles
Final deliverable is at least 1500 words

evals.prompt: Write me a comprehensive 4000-word guide on the psychology of habits — covering the science behind habit formation, why habits are so hard to break, the role of rewards and cues, and practical evidence-based techniques for building good habits and breaking bad ones. This is for a general audience health and wellness website.
evals.expected_output: A complete ~4000-word article. Should show HIVE ANALYSIS block, Construct+Knowledge task family, writing-focused agent roster, and final integrated document.
assertions: Output contains a HIVE ANALYSIS block
At least one final deliverable file exists in outputs/ directory
Final document is at least 3000 words
Document covers all 4 required topics: formation science, why hard to break, rewards/cues, practical techniques
Content is accessible to general audience (not overly academic)

evals.prompt: I'm running a bootstrapped SaaS startup in the project management space targeting small design agencies (5-20 people). I have 3 months of runway left. I need to decide between doubling down on content marketing, trying paid acquisition, building a referral program, or pivoting to a different segment. Do a proper analysis with tradeoffs and give me a concrete recommendation I can act on this week.
evals.expected_output: A decision analysis document with structured options comparison, risk analysis, and a concrete recommendation with next steps.
assertions: Output contains a HIVE ANALYSIS block with Decide (or hybrid) task family
At least one final deliverable file exists in outputs/ directory
A clear concrete recommendation is made (not just 'it depends')
Recommendation includes specific next steps for this week
